package main
import("encoding/json";"fmt";"os";"strconv";"strings";syntax "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast")
func main(){
 kinds:=map[string]int{};for kind:=syntax.Kind(0);kind<syntax.KindCount;kind++{kinds[strings.TrimPrefix(kind.String(),"Kind")]=int(kind)}
 for _,path:=range os.Args[1:]{
  data,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil{panic(err)}
  var rule struct{Name string;Kinds []string};if err:=json.Unmarshal(data,&rule);err!=nil{panic(err)}
  values:=[]string{};for _,name:=range rule.Kinds{value,ok:=kinds[name];if !ok{panic(name)};values=append(values,strconv.Itoa(value))}
  fmt.Println(rule.Name+"\t"+strings.Join(values,","))
 }
}
